1: // Pixel Dodger game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width;
12:   const height = canvas.height;
13:   // Audio setup
14:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
15:   // Resume audio context on first user interaction
16:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
17:   document.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, { once: true });
18: 
19:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
20:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
21:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
22:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
23:     osc.type = 'sine';
24:     osc.connect(gain);
25:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
26:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
27:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
28:     osc.start();
29:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
30:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
31:   }
32: 
33:   // Player settings (circle)
34:   const player = {
35:     radius: 8,
36:     x: width / 2,
37:     y: height - 15,
38:     speed: 4,
39:     color: '#00ff00',
40:   };
41: 
42:   // Block settings
43:   const blocks = [];
44:   let blockSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
45:   let lastSpawn = 0;
46:   let fallingSpeed = 2;
47: 
48:   let score = 0;
49:   let gameOver = false;
50: 
51:   // Input handling
52:   const keys = { left: false, right: false };
53:   document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
54:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') keys.left = true;
55:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') keys.right = true;
56:   });
57:   document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
58:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') keys.left = false;
59:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') keys.right = false;
60:   });
61: 
62:   function spawnBlock() {
63:     const size = Math.random() * 6 + 8; // random size between 8-14
64:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
65:     const hue = Math.floor(Math.random() * 360);
66:     const color = `hsl(${hue}, 80%, 60%)`;
67:     blocks.push({ x, y: -size, w: size, h: size, color });
68:     // Play spawn sound
69:     playTone(300, 0.07);
70:   }
71: 
72:   function update(dt) {
73:     // Move player
74:     if (keys.left) player.x -= player.speed;
75:     if (keys.right) player.x += player.speed;
76:     // Keep within bounds
77:     if (player.x - player.radius < 0) player.x = player.radius;
78:     if (player.x + player.radius > width) player.x = width - player.radius;
79: 
80:     // Spawn blocks based on interval
81:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > blockSpawnInterval) {
82:       spawnBlock();
83:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
84:     }
85: 
86:     // Update blocks
87:     for (let i = blocks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
88:       const b = blocks[i];
89:       b.y += fallingSpeed;
90:       // Check collision with player
91: // Circle-rectangle collision detection
92: {
93:   const nearestX = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(player.x, b.x + b.w));
94:   const nearestY = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(player.y, b.y + b.h));
95:   const dx = player.x - nearestX;
96:   const dy = player.y - nearestY;
97: if (dx * dx + dy * dy < player.radius * player.radius) {
98:       gameOver = true;
99:       // Play collision/game over sound
100:       playTone(150, 0.3);
101:     }
102: }
103:       // Remove off-screen blocks and increment score
104:       if (b.y > height) {
105:         blocks.splice(i, 1);
106:         if (!gameOver) {
107:           score++;
108:           // Play score sound
109:           playTone(600, 0.08);
110:         }
111:       }
112:     }
113: 
114:     // Gradually increase difficulty
115:     if (!gameOver && score % 10 === 0 && score !== 0) {
116:       fallingSpeed = Math.min(fallingSpeed + 0.2, 8);
117:       blockSpawnInterval = Math.max(blockSpawnInterval - 50, 400);
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   function draw() {
122:     // Background gradient
123:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
124:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#111');
125:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
126:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
127:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
128: 
129:     // Draw player as glowing circle
130:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,255,0,0.6)';
131:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
132:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
133:     ctx.beginPath();
134:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
135:     ctx.fill();
136:     ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
137:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
138: 
139:     // Draw blocks with gradient fill
140:     blocks.forEach((b) => {
141:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(b.x, b.y, b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h);
142:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff8080');
143:       grad.addColorStop(1, b.color);
144:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
145:       ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
146:     });
147: 
148:     // Draw score with slight shadow
149:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
150:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
151:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
152: 
153:     // Game over overlay
154:     if (gameOver) {
155:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
156:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
157:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
158:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
159:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
160:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
161:     }
162:   }
163: 
164:   let lastTime = 0;
165:   function loop(timestamp) {
166:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
167:     lastTime = timestamp;
168:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
169:     draw();
170:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
171:   }
172: 
173:   // Start loop
174:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
175: })();

(End of file - total 175 lines)
